# Desktop UI

Solid 1.9 components for native forms, stable validation feedback, accessible navigation, modal dialogs, popovers and window-level notifications. Field titles provide static accessible names. Select and MultiSelect display a down chevron. Combobox displays paired chevrons, searches inside the popup and accepts one option record or an ordered array with `multiple`. Use `searchLabel` for the popup editor, `query` and `onQueryChange` for its text, and `filter={false}` for host-filtered results. The ref points to the field button. Search text and submitted keys have independent lifetimes. The optional virtual renderer uses `present` to retain its visible rows through exit. Selected chips scroll within a single row and can be removed directly. The input family includes numeric stepping, native date segments with a themed calendar, and CSS color editing with alpha. Their editors and action columns share one focus border. Dedicated subpaths provide CodeMirror Markdown editing, safe previews, Unovis charts and Pragmatic Drag and Drop integration with automatic scrolling and compact drag previews.

Install one Toaster per document and call toast.show from UI code. Messages survive their caller and follow the active modal. Cards enter and leave from the bottom, and the queue repositions existing cards from their painted positions. Ended handles stay inert. DialogHeader, DialogBody and DialogFooter keep headings and actions around independently scrolling content. Pass a localized `closeLabel` to `DialogHeader` for a title-bar exit. FormFeedback shows the focused field’s correction and optional explanation. With no erroneous field focused, it shows a localized count that locates the first error. Hover or keyboard focus also reveals clipped text. Anchored and modal surfaces animate their frames while text and scroll geometry stay at their final size. Chart tooltips animate on visibility changes and follow the pointer directly. String templates render as text, and structured tooltips can return an HTMLElement. Markdown formatting actions use a compact tinted toolbar with foreground hover feedback. Controls share outline MDI symbols, compact segmented styling, native scrollbars and reduced-motion behavior.

Import the built component subpaths and `@kisaki3/desktop-ui/styles.css`. The stylesheet includes the desktop appearance defaults and supports ordinary CSS and Tailwind layer overrides. Runtime support follows the desktop Chromium baseline; SSR and other browser engines are not part of this release's verified scope.
